envelope.description: Add the compact native assessment bridge

body.title: Add the compact native assessment bridge
body.summary: Add strictly versioned compact-v1 read/progress/reply inputs at the existing native MCP boundary. Host resolves short aliases, supplies bound identities/sequences, translates explicit member assessments into existing domain operations and returns durable ACKs. Add valid change/context targets, safe typed errors, minimal focused view and accepted terminal acknowledgement without altering authoritative kernel contracts.
acceptanceChecks: Catalog, child MCP validation, parent authorization and translation agree on one pinned private protocol; existing bound-v1 path remains readable and explicitly routed.
Insertion/deletion absent sides never fabricate spans; wider/cross-file context uses pinned context reads. Refusals include safe corrective hints without raw private log content.
A real domain-backed integration test performs read -> semantic assessment -> journal commit -> ACK; a lost ACK does not duplicate accepted work.

Host expands only explicitly assessed members and retains unknown/unresolved dispositions. Foreign evidence, fabricated aliases, malformed compact messages and final CLI ACK without accepted reply cannot grant completion.

Prompt includes detailed tasks/checks, exact selected packet metadata and one focus block; remaining time and accepted progress are returned without repeating protocol hashes/full empty ledger. All catalog/schema/history/output reserves remain within existing inclusive budget.
